pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER — high 5xx rate detected on control plane (eu-west-1). alert: controlplane-deps-500s. severity: P1. paging: @alice (oncall) and @ben (backup)

alice: on it. seeing a spike in auth and orglookup 502/504s starting ~5732109600. routing errors to gateway appear correlated.

alice: top-level metric: controlplane 5xx from 0.3% -> 6.7% in last 3m. customer-facing errors: ~4% of requests failing for token-auth flows.

charu: i can confirm increase from logs: auth-service return 502 on validate_token calls. upstream errors show connection resets.

ben: tagging infra (maria) — can you check host heartbeats & connection pools from auth cluster?

maria: telemetry shows heartbeat misses to orglookup-db replicas and a burst of TCP RSTs from host 10.12.45.21. also noticed config-push at 5732108400 to gateway upstream weights.

dan: hmm, recent gateway config changed weight balancing -> might have skewed traffic to a flaky auth node. rolling back that config is fast option.

alice: agree. initiating roll-back of gateway-upstream-weight change. will also open circuit to the failing node.

ops-bot: deploy rollback triggered by alice @ 5732110122 — rollback id: rb-2026-03-15-01. status: in-progress.

alice: rolling back now. command: 
```
deploy rollback rb-2026-03-15-01 --service gateway --env prod --region eu-west-1
```

charu: meanwhile, enabling circuit-breaker on auth validate_token path to quickly fallback to cached checks. config patch: 
```
route /v1/validate_token {
  circuit_breaker max_concurrent: 50, error_threshold: 30%
  fallback: use_local_cache
}
```

ben: adding short-term TTL bump for orglookup cache to reduce orglookup pressure: ttl from 30s -> 300s.

maria: heartbeat to node 10.12.45.21 shows high retransmits. I suspect kernel-level networking flaps. infra is isolating host and draining connections.

alice: status update: rollback applied at 5732110300, gateway weight back to steady. early signal: 5xx down from 6.7% -> 3.1% in next ~90s.

charu: circuit-breaker enabled and local cache active. orglookup cache TTL bumped. auths falling to 1.2% 5xx after cache priming.

ops-bot: pager update: customer-impact: ~20% of API keys in EU region experienced transient failures (mostly token validation) between 5732109600 and 5732110500. ongoing mitigation reduced impact significantly.

ben: prepping follow-up tasks: replace flaky host, run postmortem, add canary for gateway-config weight changes, and add health check spike detection for auth upstreams.

alice: handing off to ben for post-incident and blameless postmortem. ben is oncall backup — please take over timeline and comms.

ben: taking over. I'll coordinate notif to support and impacted customers. rough timeline I have so far:
- 5732109600: auth/orglookup 5xx began
- 5732109875: automated alert triggers
- 5732110122: rollback started
- 5732110300: rollback completed
- 5732110420: circuit-breaker + cache TTL applied
- 5732111200: 5xx near baseline

maria: infra action: isolating host 10.12.45.21 and evacuating pods. repro steps saved to /var/log/incident/5732109999/network-rt.log

dan: quick follow-up: add a safety check to prevent large upstream-weight diffs > 20% without canary. opened PR: pr/infra/weights-safety (assign charu).

charu: ack. i'll review PR. also will add telemetry alert for connection reset spikes per backend host.

alice: customer comms: support draft ready, will send at 5732113000 once ben signs off. include note: temporary authentication failures in eu-west-1 between 5732109600-5732110500; mitigation: rollback + circuit-breaker + cache TTL.

ben: signed off on draft. sending now. :email: (support ticket #INC-2026-0315-001)

sidharth: tiny ask — can we add a short-term synthetic check hitting token-validate endpoint via region edge to detect recurrence? i'll add in monitoring.

alice: thanks team. final note: postmortem owner ben. timeline collection and tracer spans saved under /traces/incidents/5732109999. we will run RCA and action items tracked in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:

ben: leaving this thread for the on-call summary. closing the pager. if anything new pops, ping me.

pagerduty-bot: Pager closed by ben at 5732114500 — status: mitigated.
